# Terabyte Shop

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Brazilian online computer hardware store, founded in Curitiba. Sells processors, graphics cards, memory, SSDs, pre-assembled gaming PCs, peripherals, monitors, notebooks, smartphones and networking gear. Its llms.txt states it delivers across Brazil via Correios and other carriers.
